cameras.name: Cameras
cameras.description: Live camera feeds via go2rtc and UniFi Protect

versions.changelog:
Fix clip OOM; recover stuck/stalled streams; no black frame on start (#56)

- Event clips: export to a disk cache under BDH_DATA_DIR and stream them
  (with Range support) instead of buffering whole MP4s in memory.  Opening
  events OOM-killed the 128 MiB container, which also restarted go2rtc.
- Player watchdog: restart a tile (backing off up to 30 s) that never
  starts, whose peer connection closed/failed, or whose decoded frame
  count stops moving while it shows LIVE.
- Keep the video invisible until it has presented real frames (poster
  shows meanwhile); reveal high-res only after its first real frame.
- Start a new tab's streams on the next tick; more stream state in the
  remote frame stats.

Report per-stream state to the hub remote (2.5.0) (#55)

Registers a bdh.stats provider (bdh-sdk 0.33+, no-op on older SDKs) so the
hub's remote 'frame state' command returns each tile's stream name, mode,
peer-connection state, card state and video readiness/frame counts. Used by
the display soak to check that tiles are live and decoding.
Pop-ups: rebuild the player when the stream stalls (#54)
Rethink Settings > Cameras around the NVR (#52)
Pop-up triggers from any Home Assistant instance (#51)
Remove legacy pop-up and numbered Protect settings (#50)
NVRs settings page (2.2.0) (#49)
Cache PTZ probe results so refreshes don't trip Protect's rate limit (2.1.4) (#48)
Black first paint, early rail layout, cached live posters (2.1.3) (#47)
Cameras 2.1.2: quiet go2rtc 'config file disabled', memory_mb 128 (#46)
Cameras 2.1.1: settings-only Protect config (UNIFI_PROTECT_* env fallback removed) (#45)
Cameras 2.1.0: ship as its own image (#44)
Cameras 2.0.0: run in its own container (hub_api 2) (#43)

device_control.name: Controls
device_control.description: Lodge device controls (lights, blinds, fireplace, Gemstone Lights) via Home Assistant

versions.changelog:
Fireplace: read the registry via ha.registry instead of ha.ws (2.0.1) (#10)

The Fireplace tab used ha.ws_commands, which needs the admin-only ha.ws
grant, so it 502'd in the container. bdh-sdk 0.32's ha.get_registry goes
through the hub's read-only ha.registry op, covered by the manifest's
ha.read globs (Napoleon only has climate/light/number/select/switch).
Output to the card is unchanged.

Port to hub API 2 container model (2.0.0) (#9)

- Manifest: api_version 2, network outbound, lifecycle always, 128 MB,
  least-privilege ha.read/ha.call per domain/service, media.
- gemstone_password is a SECRET (bdh_sdk.secrets with legacy env fallback).
- Gemstone aiohttp session uses trust_env so HTTPS_PROXY is honoured.
- Broker refusals (PermissionDenied) degrade to 502 / hidden fireplaces.
- Tests against FakeBroker; README container section.
Use shared hub scroll hint (#7)

versions.changelog:
Return 403 to anonymous visitors instead of a login redirect (2.0.1) (#8)

In the app container there is no hub login page, and Django's
login_required redirect imports contrib.auth models the runtime doesn't
install, so anonymous requests crashed with a 500.

Vacation mode 2.0.0: hub API 2 container (#7)

- HA access via bdh_sdk.ha (broker-mediated) instead of direct requests to HOMEASSISTANT_URL
- modes_api_key is now a SECRET setting (secrets.get with legacy BDL_MODES_API_KEY fallback)
- Manifest: api_version 2, least-privilege ha.read/ha.call grants, network lan, lifecycle always, 96 MB
- Tests: HA mocks via bdh_sdk.ha, manifest permission-coverage test, FakeBroker integration tests
- README: container section and settings to seed
Gate owner features on is_admin instead of sign-in (#5)
